defaultSeo.title: Eye Hospital in Gujarat Since 1993 | Aakash Eye Hospital
defaultSeo.description: Aakash Eye Hospital is a network of six eye hospitals in Gujarat, founded in Visnagar in 1993, with hospitals in Ahmedabad, Gota, Juhapura, Himmatnagar and Bharuch.
defaultSeo.imageAlt: The Aakash Eye Hospital building in Visnagar, with the Gujarati signboard over the entrance

aboutJourney.title: Our Journey Since 1993 | Aakash Eye Hospital
aboutJourney.description: How Aakash Eye Hospital grew from one Visnagar clinic in 1993: phaco cataract surgery from 1995, laser vision correction from 2009, Ahmedabad from 2014.

aboutVision.title: Vision, Mission and Core Values | Aakash Eye Hospital
aboutVision.description: The mission, vision and core values behind Aakash Eye Hospital: only the care each patient truly needs, affordable and ethical, one standard everywhere.

footer.emergencyNote: For sudden vision loss, an eye injury, severe pain or a red eye that is getting worse, call the helpline above or go to your nearest hospital straight away.
disclaimers: Treatment information on this website is general in nature and is written for patients and their families. It describes the care available at Aakash Eye Hospital; it is not a diagnosis, a treatment plan, or a substitute for an examination by an ophthalmologist. Results differ from person to person, and the procedure that suits one eye may not suit another.

Every treatment decision here follows an examination and a conversation with your surgeon that covers the alternatives, the risks and the expected recovery. Consultation and procedure charges depend on the tests you need, the lens or technology chosen, and any insurance or scheme cover, so please ask the OPD desk for a written estimate before a procedure is scheduled.
